# BooksAtlas

> BooksAtlas (booksatlas.app; also written Booksatlas, BookAtlas or Bookatlas) is an online eBook store, in-browser reader and self-publishing platform for independent authors, run by Atlantean Globals Services in Zwolle, the Netherlands. Authors upload an EPUB, Word or PDF manuscript; BooksAtlas converts it to a store-ready EPUB, checks it with the official EPUBCheck, sells it to readers worldwide and can add a natural Google Gemini audiobook narration.

Readers can read a free preview of every book in the browser without an account, buy eBooks with iDEAL, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and other local methods, and listen to books. BooksAtlas serves readers worldwide, including every country in Africa, and has a special focus on African literature, the African diaspora, consciousness and spiritual books.

## For authors

- [Publish your eBook](https://booksatlas.app/): upload EPUB, Word (.docx) or PDF. Word and PDF are converted to EPUB 3 in the browser; chapters come from headings, the cover from the book.
- Book details (title, author, description, categories, keywords) are filled in from the manuscript automatically, without AI, and improved by a free AI model when available.
- Store-ready preparation: covers with a back panel are cropped, copyright years checked, old EPUB versions upgraded, then validated with EPUBCheck and reviewed before publication.
- Sell worldwide: the author keeps 81% of each sale price excluding VAT (BooksAtlas commission 19%). No upfront cost. BooksAtlas handles VAT and sends buyers invoices.
- Natural audiobook narration (add-on): the book is read by a Google Gemini studio voice (Sulafat, warm female; or Charon, informative male), recorded once and streamed to readers with the paragraph highlighted. Price incl. 21% VAT: €24.99 up to 60,000 words (about 220 pages), plus €3.99 per extra 10,000 words; for example about €32.97 for a 290-page book and €40.95 for a 350-page technical book. Code examples and tables are not read aloud.
- Sales dashboard: units, revenue, refunds and the author's share per book and per month.
- Print: BooksAtlas sells and ships printed copies (paperback and hardcover, printed on demand, shipped worldwide); authors keep 81% of the price excluding VAT after printing. Readiness reports for Amazon KDP and Lulu are included for authors who also publish there.

## For readers

- [Bookstore](https://booksatlas.app/): free preview of every book; buyers read the whole book in the browser.
- Refunds follow EU consumer law: 14-day right of withdrawal unless the reader asked for immediate access; faulty books always refunded. [Refund Policy](https://booksatlas.app/refunds)
- [Privacy Notice](https://booksatlas.app/privacy) · [Legal Notice](https://booksatlas.app/legal)

## Frequently asked

- How much does it cost to publish an eBook on BooksAtlas? Nothing upfront. BooksAtlas takes a 19% commission on each sale; the author keeps 81% of the price excluding VAT.
- Can I upload a Word document or a PDF? Yes. BooksAtlas converts .docx and .pdf to EPUB 3 in your browser, keeps your chapters and takes the cover from your book.
- Can my eBook become an audiobook? Yes, with natural Gemini narration from €24.99 (incl. VAT), priced by length.
- How do readers pay? iDEAL, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Bancontact, Klarna and more, through Stripe, in euros.
- Where is BooksAtlas based? Zwolle, the Netherlands (EU).
